The '''VCX series''' was a series of modern [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] put out by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Ships in the VCX series were well armed or very fast vessels produced during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="G2">{{GamerCite|2|A Legacy of Starships}}</ref>
